description:
Parent: fz-kdt

STATE (2026-08-30): fz-kdt.69.1 and .69.2 LANDED; .69.3 blocked on
fz-kdt.80 and fz-kdt.76; Story 4 (non-shift supersession) moot until a
Story 3 exists. The original seam this ticket named (a preserved claim
keeping its claim while losing its subscriptions) is now bounded: the
remaining preservation is Activation-kind only, and the strategic answer has
moved to fz-kdt.74 (stable cells make the seam unrepresentable).

## Landed

- fz-kdt.69.1 (b42e4b3ca): retraction of a caller-discovered Activation
  STICKS. SeedActivation produces exactly while nothing else publishes the
  key's inputs (ownership predicate; no positive registry of latent keys
  exists). The self-gate concludes re-listing standing claims AND standing
  reads -- claims keep the subscriptions that derived them (a one-absent-read
  conclusion was measured to settle 30 facts from amnesia; a bare wait
  wedges retraction-heavy drives). SeedActivation runs 27/2/20 with
  preservation on OR off (was 73/7/27 off). Recipe: fz2 interp, debug,
  three target fixtures.
- fz-kdt.69.2 (84ae179b4): every REACHED callsite publishes an edge.
  CallSiteResolution three-state value model -- absent = the call never
  happens; Unresolved = reached, no nameable target (lattice BOTTOM: cannot
  overwrite Resolved, re-emission quiet); Resolved(activation: None) =
  provider boundary. CallSiteSummary/Targets preservation arms DELETED.
  Downstream byte-identical (574-fixture sweep + canon compare).

## Refuted (2026-08-30, built in full, not committed)

Story 3 as designed -- demand derived from live edges over today's
value-keyed identities -- is falsified by measurement:
1. The edge is a STRICT SUBSET of stated demand: coalescing publishes only
   the rebuilt key while the walk's evidence uses pre-coalesce keys (13/0/4
   lost keys/drive); edge-derived demand starves the root's own analysis
   into a transport panic on both key-losing fixtures. -> fz-kdt.80.
2. Decommission is non-terminating while analyze_tail truncates at absent
   return evidence: retraction -> ground shift -> truncated rebased walk ->
   re-abandonment. 4,110 completion-time cycles (1,297 drain-time; control
   without retraction: 2). -> fz-kdt.76 (hard gate).
3. 'Cascade depth >=2 = zero' was preservation masking abandonment: first
   real discharge cascades to depth 5; 'decommissions <= 30/4/12' off by two
   orders of magnitude.
Also: the edge value cannot carry correlated rows (fz-kdt.81); a withdrawn
contribution propagates as an ascent (fz-kdt.82, gates fz-kdt.64).

WIP reference (probes included, not gate-clean): wt/kdt693-index @
9d65ab25e. Salvage worth keeping in any successor: refcount reduces to the
fact table's publisher set (no second count); same-completion
migrate-away-and-back is a non-event via replace_outputs; drain-time
discharge is the right trigger shape.

## Reproduced foundation (at 84ae179b4, fz2 interp debug, take_drop/range_map/predicate)

Activation true-preservation 256/21/171; ~95% of raw preservation events are
no-ops (re-emitted and deduped); the ActivationInputs self-gate fires 0x;
the tripwire state (Activation absent + inputs published) occurs 0x across
259/76/238 seed refusals.

## Path forward

fz-kdt.69.3 is CLOSED as refuted; the cell alternative (fz-kdt.74) was then
itself refuted by cold review. What remains live from this ticket's line:
fz-kdt.80 (edge honesty -- standalone correctness), fz-kdt.76 (truncation --
hard gate under every model), fz-kdt.81 (correlated carrier, census-gated).
The campaign's direction is decided by fz-kdt.83's census.
title: Demand-model repair: retraction and three-valued edges landed; live-edge derivation refuted
